value.rationale: Reliability and hazard functions are explicit headline properties of the proposed heavy-tailed lifetime model. The printed formulas become negative on an ordinary parameter setting and make the subsequent log-survival heavy-tail proof undefined as written. The one-sign correction restores valid probabilities, reconciles the paper's own tail table and hazard plot, and yields the exact positive tail laws S(t)~C t^{-q} and h(t)~q/t.
